name: YTKACE Source
subtitle: Unofficial SideStore source for YTKACE
description: SideStore source for YTKACE, an open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader for iOS. Builds are pulled from the official GitHub releases at github.com/itzzace/ytkace.

apps.name: YTKACE
apps.subtitle: YouTube enhancer and downloader
apps.localizedDescription:
YTKACE is a free, open-source YouTube enhancer and downloader for iOS.

Features:
• Downloads: video, audio, Shorts and whole playlists
• Queue: play next / play last without Premium
• Playback: background playback, PiP, loop, speed controls, gestures
• SponsorBlock: category controls, progress markers, skip modes
• Interface: OLED mode, overlay controls, navigation cleanup
• Liquid Glass styling on iOS 26
• Tabs: hide, reorder and add YouTube destinations
• Searchable settings in 15 languages

No activation service, analytics, telemetry or updater.

Two builds are published: the iOS 17+ build (YouTube 21.41.5) and an iOS 16 build (YouTube 21.33.6). SideStore installs the one that matches your device.
